 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ASHOK KUMAR PANDEY  ORAL ORDER 3 10-02-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2.
The petitioner has prayed for regular bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 376(d)/34, 354(B)/34, 363, 366 and 342 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The case of the prosecution is that the daughter of the informant along with her two children were kidnapped by the petitioner along with others.

It is further alleged that she was also carrying Rs.
28,500/- and ornaments worth Rs. 5,00,000/-.

During the course of investigation, the victim was recovered and her statement has been recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. in which she has stated that the petitioner along with others have kidnapped and established physical relation with her.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.87014 of 2024(3) dt.10-02-2025 4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in connection with the present case.
It is further submitted that the victim has denied for medical examination.
Further submission that all the other co-accused persons have been extended the privilege of bail by the Court below itself.
Moreover, the petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 28.04.2024.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, this court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

The above named petitioner is directed to be released on bail in connection with Sessions Trial No. 500 of 2024 arising out of Kanti P.S.
